name: locald-vscode
description: Local development environment powered by locald

languageModelTools.name: locald_ensure
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Ensure locald-managed services are ready, then return semantic origins and publication state for externally managed services

languageModelTools.name: locald_services
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List managed and externally published service identities for the current project, including status, semantic origin, health, and publication guidance

languageModelTools.name: locald_restart
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Restart locald-managed services for the current project and wait for readiness; externally published services use their owning workflow

service.description: Name of a specific service to restart

languageModelTools.name: locald_logs
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Fetch recent log output from locald-managed services; externally published services keep logs in their owning workflow

service.description: Name of a specific service to get logs from

lines.description: Number of log lines to return (default 200)

languageModelTools.name: locald_open
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open a locald-owned stable service origin in VS Code's Simple Browser, including unavailable published-service guidance

service.description: Name of the service to open (opens first service with a URL if omitted)

scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test .test-out/test/*.test.js
scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --skip-license -o locald-vscode.vsix
scripts.dev: npm run install-ext && echo 'Extension installed. Reload VS Code window to activate.'
